title: GLISTER: Generalization based Data Subset Selection for Efficient and Robust Learning

anchors.paraphrase_zh: GLISTER-Online 不是永久冻结一个子集，而是按间隔 L 重新选择，并在两次刷新之间继续使用上一子集。

anchors.quote: Random: Just randomly select k (budget size) training examples
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 主实验把同样子集大小 k 的随机选择作为效率基线，并在类别不平衡情形使用类别平衡随机版本。
消融显示集合正则在较大子集时能缓解对小验证集的过拟合，说明方向目标与覆盖约束应分开检验。

anchors.quote: we find that the accuracy degradation is considerable
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 作者明确报告某些加速近似会造成明显精度退化，因此理论目标的近似质量和选择计算成本不能忽略。

formulas: S* = argmin_{S subset U, |S|<=k} L_V(argmin_theta L_T(theta,S),V)
G_theta(S) = LL_V(theta + eta * grad_theta LL_T(theta,S), V)
the Taylor marginal is proportional to the dot product between a candidate training gradient and the current validation gradient
the validation-loss decrease condition requires grad L_V(theta_l)^T grad L_T(theta_l,S) >= 0
algorithm_steps: Initialize a size-k training subset and model parameters, then train one epoch at a time on the active subset.
Every L epochs, approximate the bilevel validation objective with one training step and greedily select a new subset of size k.
Optionally regularize the validation objective with facility-location or random set functions to reduce validation-set overfitting.
Reuse the selected subset between refreshes and return the final model and final subset.
selection_timing: Selection is model-state dependent and occurs every L epochs; the paper fixes L=20 in the main experiments rather than selecting every optimizer step.
refresh_rule: GreedyDSS replaces the active size-k subset at each refresh; between refresh epochs the immediately preceding subset and weights remain active.

budget.unique_sample_definition: Each refresh produces a set of at most k distinct training examples; identity can change across refreshes.
budget.repeat_definition: A selected example is revisited during every epoch for which its subset remains active, but the paper does not equalize per-example repeats across methods.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: Optimizer-visible exposure is the sum of active subset sizes over epochs; the paper reports subset percentages and equal epoch counts rather than a matched cumulative-exposure ledger.
budget.compute_cost: Subset selection uses validation and training gradients; last-layer, Taylor, stochastic-greedy and r-greedy approximations reduce selection overhead, which is included in reported wall-clock speedups.

random_baselines: uniform random subset with the same cardinality k
class-balanced random subset under class imbalance
random set-function regularization inside the GLISTER objective
checkpoint_selection: Main comparisons use the models reached under the stated training schedules; a separate business-metric checkpoint-selection rule is not reported.

results.claim: 在 CIFAR-10 的固定子集训练中，GLISTER 以较小精度损失换取明显墙钟加速。
results.value: reported speedups are 6x, 2.5x and 1.5x at 10%, 30% and 50% subsets, with accuracy drops of 3%, 1.2% and 0.2%

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 该收益是子集训练效率结果，包含选样时间，但不是固定累计 replay 曝光下的增益。

results.claim: 刷新频率和近似强度存在明确的效率与精度折中，并非越频繁选择越好。
results.value: L=20 and r about 3% of k are reported as the best observed trade-off; smaller L costs efficiency and larger L hurts accuracy

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 动态重选存在有效时间尺度，过于频繁或过于稀疏都可能降低净收益。

ablations: Taylor refresh counts r from 1 to 20
last-layer, Taylor, stochastic-greedy and r-greedy approximations
negative_results: CRAIG performs poorly at small subset sizes in the reported deep-learning comparisons.
Selecting more often than every 20 epochs did not provide accuracy gains worth its efficiency cost in the reported ablation.
Larger refresh intervals reduced accuracy, while stochastic r-greedy could produce poor sets when many items were chosen per greedy round.
A small validation set can overfit selection; facility-location or random regularization helped particularly for larger subsets.
failure_conditions: The held-out target set is biased, too small, or reused later for method selection, causing validation-target overfitting or leakage.
The one-step Taylor approximation is poor at the current model state, so gradient alignment does not predict the true post-training effect.
Subset refresh frequency or approximation budget is mismatched to training dynamics.
A cardinality-matched random baseline still receives a different cumulative optimizer-visible exposure or training-step count.
limitations: The task is subset training for efficiency and robustness, not base-data-plus-finite-budget replay.
Same epoch counts imply different optimizer-visible examples and steps, so the experiment does not isolate selection utility under equal cumulative exposure.
Independent training-seed counts and cross-seed win rates are not reported in the main paper.
The objective is generic validation likelihood or accuracy, not the Stage1 FN95 local safety frontier.
stage1_mechanism_zh: GLISTER 为 A 和 D 提供可迁移机制：先用独立 val_target 定义 FN95 局部目标梯度，再在候选集合层面优化与该梯度同向的边际，并用来源或特征覆盖正则抑制冗余。Stage1 必须把刷新时点、实际曝光和验证角色另行冻结，且用严格同预算随机回流验证干预收益。
stage1_non_inference_zh: 论文不能证明任意正梯度点积样本都值得长期 replay，也不能证明 GLISTER 排名能跨 seed 稳压随机。其子集训练减少了每轮数据量和计算量，和 Stage1 每轮完整训练 120,000 个基础样本再追加有限回流的干预不同；报告的通用准确率收益不能外推到 FN95。
